name: The Pizza Delivery Boy Who Saved the World
source:
"Look, in the sky! It's a bird! It's a plane! No, it's the delivery guy with double pepperoni and sausage! We're saved!"

It's not easy delivering pizzas for a living. My boss is a jerk, my co-workers all think I'm super-old because I'm in my 20s, and the customers...well, let's say they can be rather, umm, zesty. Like the person who doesn't know their own address. Or the guy on 12th Avenue who answers the door wearing nothing but a smile. I don't care how many abs you have, dude; that's not okay!

So when a scruffy-looking guy shows up, claiming to be me from the future? Yeah, it's easy to just brush him off. ...Until it isn't, and I'm being hunted down by an organization with an unhealthy fixation on cat experimentation. But we'll get to that. For now, rest assured: your pizza IS on its way—and it's coming with a side order of righteousness!

- Doug Rivers

It's The Pizza Delivery Boy Who Saved the World! A brand-new visual novel by a former delivery boy who is probably never going to work in the pizza industry again, if his boss finds out he made this game. From the people who brought you [url=/v19822]Cat President: A More Purrfect Union[/url]—a game Kotaku described as "an actual PC video game"—Pizza Boy is sure to delight your taste buds! (And the game is great, too.)

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/853300/The_Pizza_Delivery_Boy_Who_Saved_the_World/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“看，在天上！是一只鸟！是一架飞机！不，是送双意大利辣香肠和香肠的送货员！我们得救了！”

以送披萨为生并不容易。我的老板是个混蛋，我的同事都认为我太老了，因为我才20多岁，而顾客……好吧，可以说他们可以相当，嗯，热情。就像不知道自己地址的人一样。或者是第12大道上那个开门的人，脸上除了微笑什么也没有。我不在乎你有多少块腹肌，伙计；那不行！

那么当一个衣衫褴褛的家伙出现并声称是来自未来的我时呢？是的，很容易把他甩掉。…直到事实并非如此，我被一个对猫实验有着不健康执着的组织追捕。但我们会做到这一点。现在，请放心：你的披萨已经在路上了，而且还附带一份正义的配菜！

——道格·里弗斯

这是拯救世界的披萨送货员！这是一部全新的视觉小说，作者是一名前送货员，如果他的老板发现他制作了这款游戏，他可能再也不会在披萨行业工作了。来自为你带来[url=/v19822]猫总统：更纯洁的联盟[/url]——一款被Kotaku描述为“真正的PC视频游戏”的游戏——Pizza Boy一定会满足你的味蕾！（而且游戏也很棒。）

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/853300/The_Pizza_Delivery_Boy_Who_Saved_the_World/]Steam[/url]]
